title: Bihar AC-union versus official state-boundary coverage screening

computation.method: Shapely 2.1.2; ArcGIS ring orientation used to group exterior/hole rings; invalid polygons make_valid only for union/coverage comparison; transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32645; raw source bytes unchanged.
computation.note: This is a coverage screening comparison against the portal's own state polygon, not legal-boundary acceptance. It does not negate the separate invalid-feature and overlap findings.

limitations: State boundary and AC layers share the same government GIS system and may share lineage/generalization; this is not independent legal validation.
Geometry ring grouping and make_valid comparison need independent review.
The workflow audit initially missed the State_Name attribute; the selector was corrected in commit 46380877e0d27d6f10d6bc827ef27246416bf377 and a rerun is required for fully reproducible CI evidence.
Legal vintage, licence, Gazette chain, and source-owner confirmation remain open.
disposition: CANDIDATE COVERAGE SCREEN ONLY; TOPOLOGY DEFECTS REMAIN; NOT CANONICAL
